highlights: 10-in-1 Charging Station: With 6 AC Outlets, 1 USB C & 3 USB A Ports, this 10-in-1 extension lead functions as a versatile power strip and socket extensions solution, powering up to 10 devices at once. Designed for TV PC Laptops Tablets, it suits busy homes, shared flats and offices, keeping desktops tidy and well organised without cable clutter

15° Slanted Socket Layout: The innovative angled socket design prevents bulky plugs from blocking neighbouring ports. This practical plug extension socket layout improves access across all outlets, making it easier to use multiple adapters at the same time and enhancing everyday convenience for multi-device setups

20W USB-C PD Fast Charging: Supporting PD3.0 via USB-C, this 20W USB C Fast Charging Power Strip delivers up to 20W for smartphones and tablets. Intelligent power distribution keeps charging stable across USB ports, allowing the extension lead with usb slots to handle daily charging needs efficiently. Note: 20W charging is only achievable when using the USB-C port individually

Slim Design with Safety Switch: Featuring a low-profile, space-saving body, this black extension lead fits neatly under desks or beside walls. The integrated on/off safety switch helps reduce standby power consumption, making it a practical extension plug choice for both home and office environments

Built-In Electrical Safety Protection: Designed with essential electrical safety in mind, this Multiplug includes output over-current, over-voltage, short circuit and overload protection. Combined with a durable extension cord, it delivers stable and reliable power for everyday extension cable use, offering peace of mind for home and office setups
